## Description

**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**
Interested in joining a top-notch marketing team? We are looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Account-Based Marketing Manager who thrives in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and is driven by outcomes.

In this role, you will own 1:1 and 1:few account-based marketing strategy and execution for a prioritized portfolio of our most strategic Enterprise accounts, in close partnership with our Enterprise Sales team. You will lead regular account planning sessions and build the full mix of ABM tactics against your target accounts, partnering with digital, content, demand generation, and field marketing teams to bring personalized experiences to the full buying committee across the buyer's journey. Our North America ABM program is organized around the motions that drive Enterprise growth: winning new logos, progressing active opportunities, expanding existing customers, and growing alongside our partners.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close partnership across Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, and Marketing Operations, as well as strong written and verbal communication skills.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

**You should apply if:**

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
- You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

- Own 1:1 and 1:few account-based marketing strategy and execution for a prioritized portfolio of strategic Enterprise accounts
- Partner closely with Enterprise Sales teams to lead bi-weekly 1:1 account planning sessions and develop tailored plans for specific accounts
- Build buying-group plays that reach multiple stakeholders on a committee with coordinated, personalized messaging across the buyer's journey
- Act as a strategic thought partner to Sales by identifying opportunities, solving challenges, and aligning marketing effort to account priorities
- Orchestrate cross-functional partners in digital, content, demand generation, field marketing, product marketing, and marketing operations to bring account programs to life
- Own account progression and closed-loop reporting for your portfolio, delivering measurable impact on pipeline and closed-won, with a recommendation attached to every read-out
- Manage program budget with accurate cost tracking at the account and play level

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

- 6+ years of ABM, demand generation, and enterprise B2B marketing, with a focus on SaaS and high-tech solutions."
- Experience building and running 1:1 and 1:few ABM programs — account selection input, buying committee mapping, personalized content and campaign development, and hands-on familiarity with the channel mix (personalized digital, direct mail, account landing pages and content, content syndication, account-level events), including how each is built, costs, and is measured
- Track record partnering directly with enterprise AEs and sales leadership on account strategy, including running account planning sessions that Sales values
- Demonstrated ability to navigate complex account and pipeline challenges, weighing sales priorities, available resources, and channel performance
- A clear point of view on how to measure ABM impact, including how you handle the attribution ambiguity that comes with multi-touch account programs
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
- Experience working with AI tools
- Remote position open to candidates residing in the US

**An ideal candidate also has:**

- Strong attention to detail, executive presence, and excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization
- A self-starter mindset with strong leadership instincts, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-changing environment
- A passion for results, measurement, and optimization, with a focus on driving ROI and solving problems proactively
